# Subway Seat for delta

Each flavor is a delta feature: diff tints, line numbers, file and hunk headers. Syntax colours come from the bat theme, so install that too.

[delta](https://github.com/dandavison/delta) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/delta/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.gitconfig`](subway-seat.gitconfig) | ~/.config/delta/subway-seat.gitconfig |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig`](subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig) | ~/.config/delta/subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig`](subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig) | ~/.config/delta/subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig |
| All three | [`themes.gitconfig`](themes.gitconfig) | ~/.config/delta/subway-seat.gitconfig |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.gitconfig (include the file first):

```conf
[delta]
	features = subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.gitconfig (include the file first):

```conf
[delta]
	features = subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.gitconfig (include the file first):

```conf
[delta]
	features = subway-seat-enamel
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
